W5-01-rel-novels-land.title: Land the verified novels reader on the main tree
W5-01-rel-novels-land.brief: The rel-novels scout's verified decision is merged. Bring it to lane-G finish: add an oracle-refusing PASS marker to Novel_Reader_Export.thy (copy Quantity_Export.thy's pattern, keep the SHA-1 line), write the generated SML where tools/dev/remote-build already returns exports instead of fetching it with scp, add a tables_check.py that asserts the HOL readers table and domain roots equal the shipped organ's, build the norm index and binary from the main checkout, re-run the parity harness on rel-novels, and write the handoff with answer_stored and decline_stored verbatim. State plainly that the shipped verdict is 104/120 on an unshipped store and that this reader reaches 84/120 on relations_v1, with P144 absent.
W5-01-rel-novels-land.done_when: main-checkout parity for rel-novels is 84/120 right, 0 wrong, 0 false yes, 120/120 item-for-item with tools/reader-novels/probe.py; build marker VERI7VN_NOVEL_READER PASS with oracles=0; tables_check.py green

W5-02-relation-family.title: One verified kernel for all 161 relation readers
W5-02-relation-family.start_from: dev after W5-01; read the rel-census and rel-linker scout reports first (branches scout/rel-census, scout/rel-linker)
W5-02-relation-family.brief: Generalize Novel_Reader.thy so the reader table, domain roots and time-variant properties are data per specialist, keep answer_stored and decline_stored for the general kernel, and add whatever the novels panel did not exercise (inverse phrasings). Score each rel-* specialist on its own panel. Start with the specialists whose properties exist in relations_v1 (rel-census measures this), and classify every withheld item as missing property, linker miss, or agreement-rule refusal. Do not start before rel-linker has reported; the linker is shared and should not be built twice.
W5-02-relation-family.done_when: every rel-* panel scored with its own table: per-specialist right/wrong/withheld/false-yes in the handoff, 0 wrong across all, every withheld item classified

W5-03-linter-fix.title: Correct the linter's lane-cap finding, then merge it
W5-03-linter-fix.start_from: scout/specialist-linter (fix on a new branch from it, or on dev after root merges with the fix as a follow-up commit)
W5-03-linter-fix.brief: The linter's numbers reproduce, but it says the release used a lane cap of 5 and was tighter than exam.py. The three specialists that took 6 were ADMITTED, so the release did not apply a cap of 5. Rewrite that sentence in the generator (per-folder gate section and aggregate) to: the counts were taken on a sample of about 400; exam.py's formula gives 5 on that sample and 9 on the full 924; the release admitted 6. Also raise the 'not specific' cut or print each guard's base rate next to the match so a 66% guard is not read as specific. Regenerate docs/lint/specialists.md. Optional: add the 'manifest hygiene' patch output (var/lint/patch/, never upstream) for the 5 backspace regexes and 7 stale store paths.
W5-03-linter-fix.done_when: re-lint of all 305 gives 239 agree / 3 disagree / 50 insufficient / 13 without verdict, the lane-cap sentence matches the verdict files, and root has merged it

W5-04-linux-all.title: Every landed family on Linux, with receipts in git
W5-04-linux-all.brief: Run tools/deploy/linux-build.sh for every landed src/extract/* family with its specialists, on hbox and persvati alternately, comparing each against a fresh macOS run. Have the script emit a small receipt per family (binary sha256, generated-SML sha256, panel shas, verdict counts, host, glibc, libgmp) and commit those under project/deploy/receipts/ (root approves the location; binaries stay out of git). Report panel items and core-panel probes separately; the panel items are the evidence.
W5-04-linux-all.done_when: for every landed family, Linux panel verdicts equal macOS with 0 divergent replies on panel items, and one receipt file per family is committed

W5-05-fold-interception.title: Which head folds take which specialists' questions, measured
W5-05-fold-interception.start_from: W5-03 output; lane A's head-run parity data under var/parity/
W5-05-fold-interception.brief: The linter's shadow section matches guard regexes only. Replace guessing with measurement where data exists: for each specialist lane A has run behind the head, compare the linter's predicted folds with the paths the head actually took on that specialist's panel, report precision and recall of the guard-match heuristic, and name the folds whose guards are misnamed (w55 _TOKEN, w34 _world_material). Guard matches stay labelled as matches, never as takes.
W5-05-fold-interception.done_when: per-fold predicted vs measured interception on every specialist with a lane-A head run, with the heuristic's precision and recall stated

W5-06-route-column.title: Route distribution as a parity-board column
W5-06-route-column.start_from: dev; a transfer of tools/parity/ from lane A by root
W5-06-route-column.brief: The code-organ scout measured by hand that 0 of 924 core-panel items take the code route. Make that a harness output: per answerer, counts of the path prefix of every reply (organ:*, specialist_call, precision_guard, ...), so any proposed lift can be checked for whether it can move the board before it starts.
